import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV and aggregate one revenue value per month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
grouped = (df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue']
             .sum()
             .sort_values('month'))

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for region, series in grouped.groupby('region'):
    ax.plot(series['month'], series['revenue'], marker='o', label=region)

ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_title('Revenue by Month and Region')
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
